exposure: Antibiotic discontinuation within 5 days for neonates with gestational age >= 37 weeks, no documented signs or symptoms of sepsis, CRP <= 10 mg/L and negative cultures within 3 days of antibiotic initiation
outcome: Percentage of discontinued regimens by day 5
Antibiotic consumption (days of therapy (DOT) per 1000 patient-days)
cohort: Neonates in 15/17 public NICUs in Greece from 9/2016-06/2019.
finding: A low-cost and-resource intervention focused on discontinuing antibiotics early in neonates without confirmed sepsis led to a 9% increase in antibiotic discontinuation within 5 days and an overall reduction in antibiotic use.
